rules.claim: Discovery notifications must be derived from the exact verified production revision rather than an unverified repository or build state.
rules.decision: Require a passing final artifact plus complete live parity with matching source/deployed commit SHA before emitting a ready-to-submit URL set.

rules.claim: IndexNow is intended for URLs that were added, updated or deleted, not for mechanically resubmitting an unchanged canonical inventory.
rules.decision: Ready URLs are limited to added canonical URLs, Search-surface-updated canonical URLs, and removed URLs with explicit live 404/410 evidence.

rules.claim: A deployment-time byte difference can reflect non-substantive rebuild churn and is not by itself proof of a meaningful page update.
rules.decision: Keep artifact-only byte changes in watch until stronger content/Search evidence exists; do not send them automatically to IndexNow.

rules.claim: Sitemaps remain the broad canonical coverage mechanism while IndexNow is a URL-level freshness notification mechanism for participating engines.
rules.decision: Require the after-artifact sitemap to cover the canonical cohort and keep sitemap processing/status as a separate owner-platform follow-up.

rules.claim: Submission receipts and deployment parity do not prove indexing, ranking, citations or traffic.
rules.decision: Create provider-specific owner-evidence follow-ups for Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster/AI Performance and referrals without causal attribution.

guardrails: Do not notify IndexNow before exact production deployment parity is proven.
Do not mass-submit an unchanged sitemap cohort.
Do not treat a build timestamp, deployment timestamp or byte-only rebuild as proof of a meaningful page update.
Do not treat IndexNow acceptance, sitemap submission or Search Console/Bing visibility as indexing/ranking proof.
Do not send Google ordinary pages through the Google Indexing API; that applicability is governed separately by Search Platform Eligibility.
Keep owner exports private; emit only an owner-evidence queue/contract from this planner.
